exposure: estimated intraoperative blood loss of more than 1 L
cohort: The study included 11,465 women who underwent cesarean delivery between 2013 and 2023 at a high-volume tertiary obstetric center, comparing those who required a relaparotomy to a control group who did not.
finding: Emergency cesarean delivery, placenta previa, multiple gestation, estimated intraoperative blood loss exceeding 1 L, and intraoperative adhesions were identified as independent risk factors for relaparotomy after cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery was found to be a significant independent risk factor for relaparotomy following cesarean delivery.
